label: D1 after a rare-unrewarded a1 trial (a1 -> S2, no reward); agent about to stay with a1
explanation: Fires only at D1 (0% at GO/D2), only when the reward input is 0, and essentially only after the previous trial was a1 with a rare transition to S2 (prev_common=0 & prev_action=1 holds 81.6% of mass; the other ~18% is rel -3 D1, where the previous trial is outside the window and cannot be checked). Every activation precedes an upcoming a1 choice (a stay, the model-based response to rare-unrewarded), the policy logit is moderately pro-a1 (2.8..8.1), and the hidden good state is mostly S1. It never fires after rewarded trials, after common transitions, or after a2 trials. The predicate covers ~82% of activations but precision is only ~12%: the feature fires on just ~1/8 of such D1 steps. Restricting to mid-episode trials (20-79; it never fires before trial 10 or after trial 79) and to a pro-a1 policy raises precision only to ~20%, so some unidentified episode/hidden-state factor gates it. Magnitude is roughly flat across activation quartiles, with no clear modulator found. Recorded predicate uses only observed variables.
